notes: Retail prices come ONLY from retailers' own websites (fetched automatically, with URL and retrieval time), your own bills (current plan), or quotes you type in from a retailer's site. Comparison sites are never used as a price source.
All prices are stored GST-inclusive. Prices published excluding GST are converted by adding 15%.
Most Auckland retailers show prices only after an address / ICP lookup. Those are listed as "not available" with the reason and a link to their pricing page.
Vector network (lines) charges are included as context only: they are part of every retail price, not a plan you can buy.
Low-user (low fixed charge) plans are being phased out: see lowFixedCharge for the rule and its source.

lowFixedCharge.summary: Low-user daily charge capped at $1.80/day excl. GST from 1 April 2026. The regulations are removed on 1 April 2027, after which retailers no longer have to offer low-user plans. Low-user plans are for your main home using up to 8,000 kWh a year (Auckland).
